mentions.name: Sleep Signal
mentions.description: This app helps users get sleepy without medication by playing short audio prompts of micro-scenarios (e.g., "moonlight on a white flower") that listeners close their eyes and imagine until the next one plays. Sessions are kept short by default (10 minutes) and the duration can be adjusted; it is pitched as a digital melatonin pill without chemical side effects.
mentions.problem: Difficulty falling asleep without relying on medications or melatonin supplements that carry chemical side effects
mentions.audience: An app for individuals who want to fall asleep without medication
mentions.source_excerpt:
Recently worked on https://sleepsignal.app

It's an app to get sleepy without meds. Simply close your eyes and imagine the micro-scenarios you hear. Like if you hear "moonlight on a white flower", imagine that scenario until you hear the next one. Session duration is also not too long (10 minutes default, you may change the session duration too).
